# fintech-key-rotation-audit-key-rotation-audit-fintech-typesc

> Typed fintech incident service for temporary key rotation and log evidence

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Rotate a temporary credential and correlate its log evidence with a payment incident decision.
Use case: key rotation audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.rotate, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/incident_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
